verified_semantics.fact: AliveForTestUrl uses state stored for the exact URL if present; otherwise generic alive.
Each URLTest updates generic alive/history plus only its own URL-specific state/history. A gstatic test does not overwrite an existing ipify state.
Fallback uses child AliveForTestUrl for its configured URL and preserves priority order unless a valid fixed selection exists. It does not choose the lowest latency.
A group's proxy wrapper has independent test history; its test makes a connection through the group rather than copying a child result.
unified-delay resets timing to the second HEAD if it succeeds; if that request fails, the first total remains. Different samples may include different startup overhead.
The groups delay endpoint clears fixed selection and tests children; the proxies delay endpoint tests the named proxy wrapper.
Startup healthcheck runs regardless of lazy. Later idle checks may be skipped with lazy=true.

interpretation: A successful manual HY2 gstatic test can coexist with AUTO selecting TCP because AUTO's ipify health state is independent. This is a mechanism, not proof of the current failure reason.
AUTO 1305ms and REALITY 169ms may describe different requests, times, child choices and cold/warm states. Delay display alone cannot identify the child used by the old AUTO test.
Read each child's exact-URL extra alive/history and timestamps plus actual business connection chains. Generic alive or isolated HY2 success alone is insufficient.
Existing isolated fresh requests had intermittent timeouts; real healthcheck failure must remain visible rather than forced healthy.

minimum_fix_candidate.rationale: Use the app's same real HTTPS target so manual and periodic tests update the state used by AUTO; validate 204 and check during idle for bounded recovery detection.
validation: Valid HY2 target health gives HY2 priority and actual business HY2 chain.
Genuine HY2 failure gives REALITY and subsequent same-URL recovery restores HY2.
Website-selected exit and account routing rules remain correct.
limits: This is a health selection improvement, not physical RTT or sustained throughput improvement.
A single external health target can fail independently of the proxy path.
The client full profile must be refreshed once to update its health URL.

not_proposed_without_evidence: Artificial delay values or bypassing healthchecks
